blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Police arrested three suspected drug dealers and seized about 165 grams of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) worth P1.12 million in a buy-bust operation in Barangay Sto. Niño Norte, Arevalo, here early Sunday. Police identified the suspects by their aliases as “Romer,” 30, and “Jessie,” 35, both classified as high-value individuals, and “Ruping,” 24, a street-level individual. All three are from Iloilo province. The Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit 6 led the operation at 2:53 a.m. following surveillance and intelligence gathering on the suspects’ alleged involvement in the illegal drug trade.
